newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee opens steady vs dlr, may not weaken.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee opens steady vs dlr, may not weaken.

text.p: * The Indian rupee opens steady at 35.78/79 against dollar on Monday, dealers say.
* The day's broad range seen at 35.76/82 rupees a dollar.
* Some dealers say the dollar unlikely to breach 35.80 level because of usual weekend dollar remittances adding to supplies.
* Any weakening of the rupee above the 35.80 level seen attracting exporters' dollar sales, pushing up the rupee.
* The Reserve Bank of India seen entering the market at 35.76/77 level as had happened last week.
* Spot rupee quoted at 35.777/787 in latest deals.
